title: Gukesh v Sindarov, Game 2
why: Game 2 of the world championship match in Geneva ended in a draw by threefold repetition, leaving the match level after two draws; streamed free on the FIDE YouTube channel.

title: Gukesh v Sindarov, Game 3
why: Game 3 of the world championship match in Geneva, with both opening games drawn; coverage starts at 9:00 AM New York time and streams free on YouTube.

title: Players Championship Finals, Round One (Stephen Bunting v Max Hopp)
why: Bunting meets Max Hopp in round one at Minehead on Friday 27 November; sessions run 12:45-17:00 and 19:00-23:00 GMT but his slot has not been announced, and Luke Littler is not in the field.
